entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not working out for me.
Thank you for calling, I understand you'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Uh, yeah, it's order number is #VF12345.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on October 26th. Today is November 10th.
So? What's the problem? It's practically brand new! I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. However, our return window for the VeloBand Pulse, as stated in our return policy, is 10 days from the date of purchase.
Ten days? Are you kidding me? That's ridiculous! I've barely had a chance to use it! I need this money. What am I supposed to do with a useless VeloBand Pulse now?

I understand your disappointment. While a full refund isn't possible due to the expired return window, let me see if there are any options we can explore. Unfortunately, I am unable to make a policy exception in this case.
So you're telling me I'm stuck with it? This is terrible customer service!

I apologize that this isn't the outcome you were hoping for. While a refund isn't possible, I can offer you store credit for the current value of the VeloBand Pulse. You can use this towards another VeloFit product or accessory.
Store credit? Well, I guess that's better than nothing. How much store credit are we talking about?
Based on the current selling price of the VeloBand Pulse, I can offer you $75 in store credit.
Okay, alright. I'll take the store credit. How does that work?

Great. I've applied a $75 store credit to your VeloFit account, associated with the email address we have on file. You'll see it reflected immediately when you log into your account on our website or app. It will automatically apply to your next purchase. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for at least doing something. I appreciate it.
You're welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
